topic: How to encourage without nagging: the deal that works
caption:
Tired of asking your teen to get off their phone and do something?

Try the match deal: tell them you'll match the first $20 they earn this week. No nagging, just an offer they can take or leave.

Most teens take it. And that first win changes everything.

Give them a head start → hustleup.us
